headline: Lex Consult advises ONYA Diamonds on pre-Series A fundraise

detail: Mahiva Technologies Private Limited, dba ONYA Diamonds, has raised funds from a pre-Series A fundraise led by Divisa Family Office with participation from its existing investor, Zeropearl VC, and several other angel investors. Lex Consult advised ONYA Diamonds on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Naresh Pareek (Partner), with assistance from Riya Trivedi (Senior Associate), Associates Jash Doshi and Vibhor Jain. ONYA Diamonds ONYA Diamonds combines art and science to create practical and elegant jewellery pieces focusing on craftsmanship and personalised designs.
